After completing requested code changes in this repository, run the relevant tests and, if they pass, commit the task-specific changes and push the commit to `origin` on the current branch without waiting for a separate request.

Stage only files changed for the current task. Never include unrelated existing work, use force push, or push if tests fail. If committing or pushing is blocked by missing credentials, branch protection, or another error, report the failure clearly instead of claiming success.
